name: bybit-ai-quant-workspace
description: Nx + pnpm workspace for the Bybit AI Quant DSH Bundle

scripts.lint: nx run-many -t lint --projects=@bybit-quant/dsh-plugin,@bybit-quant/quant-api-client && oxlint scripts packages/ts/quant-contracts
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm bundle:check && pnpm sdk:check && pnpm sdk:test && pnpm typecheck:tooling && pnpm test:tooling
scripts.security:deps: pnpm audit --audit-level high && uv run --project python --locked pip-audit --skip-editable
scripts.python:lint: uv run --project python --locked ruff check python/packages python/apps && uv run --project python --locked ruff format --check python/packages python/apps
scripts.python:typecheck: uv run --project python --locked pyright python/packages python/apps
scripts.python:test: uv run --project python --locked pytest python/packages python/apps
